verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for a creator e-commerce platform like Gumroad, but the evidence pack never documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from a creator's own data. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: an OAuth + MCP interface that lets an external agent read sales, OpenAI used for moderation and support, and AI support chatbots.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
